# ChatUI

> A customizable, self-hosted chat interface built with Next.js that connects to any LLM backend (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, or a custom API). It offers real-time streaming, multi-provider routing, and a fully themeable UI configured from a single file.

ChatUI is a ChatGPT-style frontend that developers and teams fully own and control. All branding, theming, authentication, and backend routing live in `app/chat.config.ts`. Data is stored on the local filesystem (JSON + Markdown) with no third-party services. Released under the MIT License.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview, features, quick start, screenshots, and tech stack.
- [Configuration Guide](CONFIGURATION.md): Full reference for theme, branding, endpoints, API keys, users, environment variables, and storage.
- [Agent Notes](AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI agents working in this repository.

## Key Features

- Multi-provider support: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, or custom backends.
- Streaming responses with token-by-token display and a stop button.
- Per-option system prompts and endpoint routing.
- Full GitHub-Flavored Markdown rendering with code copy buttons.
- Configurable theme, branding, welcome screen, and suggestion chips.
- Built-in username/password authentication.
- File-based chat storage (per user).

## Getting Started

- Install dependencies: `npm install`
- Start the dev server: `npm run dev`
- Open http://localhost:3000 and sign in with the configured credentials.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
- react-markdown + remark-gfm
- File-based storage (JSON + Markdown)
